texte: Every night my mom gets a little bit smaller.
We live in the attic. In winter it gets so cold that my wick almost goes out.
So Mom sits down next to me. And burns.
In the morning there are wax drops on the floor. And Mom is shorter again.
I ask her why. She just smiles and says: I'm not cold.
Tonight she is only as tall as me.
She holds her wick to mine. And whispers: now it's your turn to stay warm.
If you want to know what was on the floor in the morning: Part 2 comes tomorrow.
